# Formation and inheritance of organizational rule differences

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every process, gate on moves and quantity of configurations: the quantity is kept along every course of ungated moves exactly when every ungated step keeps it; a course that changes it passes the gate, at a gated step that itself changes it. In the organizational protocol only adoption is gated for the rule: every other event keeps it, so every nonadopting history inherits the rule and every rule change is located at an adoption. Reviewed work and recognition form mandates; an actual proposal changes the later filtering rule through the existing authorization procedure. Branching or handoff carries that rule, continuing participation determines execution, and inherited differences change subsequent admitted decisions.

Canonical source: [OrganizationalRuleInheritance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/OrganizationalRuleInheritance.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Seed mandate, recognition/copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied; the higher amendment procedure is fixed.
- Majority uses the full recorded roster; the two-support fallback has a fourteen-day input and no-opposition condition. No real clock, consensus process or software execution is simulated.
- Work execution, capability change and the production of continued participation are not closed; admitted-decision counts are not work consequences.

Social continuations differentiate through work, mandates and retained rule histories. Branches can share participants, and inherited records do not create participation. Primary Valkey/TDF records support bounded mechanism correspondence, not empirical reproduction of the whole model. Whole and subsystems differentiate within the same activity; this protocol represents one connection, not formalized complete reciprocal feedback or changing boundaries. Exposition identifies how activity results enter later interpretation and revision, with changing order and participation. Repair and learning may form in one activity; fewer formal training sessions do not directly imply reduced capability.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

29 new theorems / 53 declaration audits, 81 audits in the actual import closure. Primary-record reading and formal checking remain separate; no independent-agent acceptance.

Only a conditional institutional connection is proved; proposal creativity, origin of highest authority, actual procedural compliance, population propagation advantage and ethical warrant remain unproved. Work/capability/participation feedback and subsystem differentiation remain unconnected; procedural completion is not completion of whole organizational dynamics.

- A copied rule without continuing participation cannot operate. Two participants may permit technical decisions while governance revision fails. Duplicate votes, inadequate time and opposition retain failure.
